name: Volatility-Filtered Momentum
description: Momentum strategy with volatility filter. Only trades when rolling volatility falls below threshold, improving signal consistency. Based on Medium research showing Sharpe ~1.2 with improved stability.
author: Jarvis - External Research (Medium/briplotnik)

entry_rules.long: Z-score of returns above threshold AND rolling volatility below max_volatility threshold
entry_rules.short: Z-score of returns below negative threshold AND rolling volatility below max_volatility threshold

exit_rules.long: Z-score reverts to mean or volatility spikes above threshold
exit_rules.short: Z-score reverts to mean or volatility spikes above threshold

max_volatility.description: Maximum allowed volatility for entry (as decimal)

vol_filtered_momentum.notes: Improved stability vs unfiltered momentum. Better in post-2021 regime.

research_notes.key_insight: Momentum is more effective during stable periods. Volatility filter improves consistency.
research_notes.risk_profile: Medium - filtered entries reduce whipsaw losses
